sources.title: Brownfield land
sources.facts: 37,671 rows; 354 providers; collector 2026-07-27; new data 2026-07-24; authoritative-source origin.

sources.guard: Register suitability and categories do not prove current availability, viability, ownership title or development delivery.

sources.title: Brownfield site
sources.facts: 2,916 sites; 5 providers; collector 2026-07-26; new data 2025-12-19; experimental and intended for later combination.
sources.guard: Experimental boundary is not the statutory register, exact legal extent or deliverability result.

sources.title: Planning permission status
sources.facts: 3 statuses; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-26; new data 2025-05-08: permissioned, not-permissioned, pending-decision.
sources.guard: Status code requires a site record and date/history checks; it is not proof permission remains extant.

sources.title: Planning permission type
sources.guard: Permission-type taxonomy is not a verified consent document, conditions or implementation status.

sources.title: Ownership status
sources.facts: 4 statuses; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-28; new data 2025-10-08 including unknown ownership.
sources.guard: Category is not HMLR title proof, beneficial ownership or control evidence.

sources.title: Site category
sources.facts: 2 categories; 1 provider; collector 2026-06-24; new data 2025-05-08: deliverable and hazardous-substances.
sources.guard: Category label does not independently prove deliverability, hazard presence or regulatory compliance.

sources.title: Planning application

sources.guard: Coverage is limited and not a complete national planning register or decision record.

sources.title: Planning application type
sources.guard: Application-type code is taxonomy, not validation, determination or permission evidence.
